title: containerprofiles.json
body:
{
 "schema": 1,
 "basis": "Container facts are labelled P (final primary text), P-draft (public MPEG drafts w23813 and w18310 with COR1), S (ExifTool 13.55 source) and N (native 13.55 observation on hand-built fixtures). Nothing here claims pixel identity, authenticity, privacy, MWG conformance or exhaustive ExifTool coverage.",
 "families": [
  "exif",
  "xmp",
  "iptc"
 ],
 "containers": {
  "tiff": {
   "locator": "tiff",
   "signatures": [
    "49492a00",
    "4d4d002a"
   ],
   "suffixes": [
    ".tif",
    ".tiff"
   ],
   "maxBytes": 268435456,
   "slots": {
    "exif": "IFD0 ExifIFD GPS InteropIFD",
    "xmp": "IFD0 tag 0x02BC",
    "iptc": "IFD0 tag 0x83BB or Photoshop resource 0x0404 of tag 0x8649"
   },
   "protected": [
    "byteOrder",
    "every IFD entry value except pointer and slot tags",
    "every strip, tile and JPEG-interchange extent by index, length and bytes",
    "InteropIFD"
   ],
   "allowedChanges": [
    "planned IFD0, ExifIFD and GPS targets",
    "tag 0x02BC",
    "tag 0x83BB",
    "closed native side effects of the container"
   ],
   "nativeSideEffects": [
    "extent offset tag values (StripOffsets, TileOffsets) change because the writer relocates image data"
   ],
   "destinations": {
    "exif": true,
    "xmp": true,
    "iptc": true
   },
   "removal": {
    "categories": [
     "location",
     "captureTime",
     "descriptive",
     "rights",
     "deviceIdentity"
    ],
    "recipes": {
     "location": "named keys and -GPS:all=",
     "xmp": "-XMP:all= (slot delete)",
     "iptc": "-IPTC:all= (slot delete)",
     "others": "named keys from the trusted listing of the capture"
    },
    "forbiddenArguments": [
     "-EXIF:all=",
     "-IFD0:all=",
     "-all="
    ],
    "thumbnails": {
     "supported": false,
     "reason": "an IFD1 in a TIFF is a page"
    }
   },
   "minimise": {
    "supported": false,
    "code": "MINIMISE_UNSUPPORTED_CONTAINER",
    "reason": "IFD0 is the image description"
   },
   "timeLocationWrite": true,
   "refusalCodes": [
    "TIFF_BIG_UNSUPPORTED",
    "TIFF_LAYOUT_OVERLAP",
    "TIFF_IMAGE_EXTENT_INVALID",
    "TIFF_IFD_BUDGET",
    "TIFF_TYPE_UNSUPPORTED",
    "TIFF_UNKNOWN_IFD_POINTER",
    "TIFF_UNKNOWN_OFFSET_SUSPECT",
    "TIFF_OFFSET_TAG_UNSUPPORTED",
    "TIFF_DUPLICATE_METADATA_TAG",
    "INVALID_EXIF_STRUCTURE",
    "RAW_FORMAT_UNSUPPORTED",
    "IPTC_RESOURCE_TAIL_UNSUPPORTED",
    "TIFF_PHOTOSHOP_IPTC_CARRIER_UNSUPPORTED",
    "TIFF_IPTC_DIGEST_UNSUPPORTED"
   ],
   "limitations": [
    "tiffUnknownTagSemanticsNotInterpreted",
    "tiffRecognisedTagSetConservative",
    "bigTiffUnsupported",
    "makerRawFormatsUnsupported",
    "photoshopResourceTailOpaque",
    "tiffPhotoshopIptcCarrierWriteUnsupported",
    "tiffIptcDigestNotRefreshable"
   ]
  },
  "dng": {
   "locator": "tiff",
   "signatures": [
    "49492a00",
    "4d4d002a"
   ],
   "detect": "IFD0 tag 0xC612 (DNGVersion); never by suffix",
   "suffixes": [
    ".dng"
   ],
   "maxBytes": 268435456,
   "slots": {
    "exif": "IFD0 ExifIFD GPS InteropIFD",
    "xmp": "IFD0 tag 0x02BC",
    "iptc": "IFD0 tag 0x83BB or Photoshop resource 0x0404 of tag 0x8649"
   },
   "protected": [
    "byteOrder",
    "every tag of every DNG image IFD except pointer and slot tags (colour, calibration, opcode, level and crop tags included)",
    "DNGPrivateData byte for byte",
    "MakerNote byte for byte",
    "raw and preview extents by index, length and bytes"
   ],
   "allowedChanges": [
    "planned IFD0, ExifIFD and GPS targets",
    "tag 0x02BC",
    "tag 0x83BB",
    "closed native side effects of the container"
   ],
   "nativeSideEffects": [
    "extent offset tag values (StripOffsets, TileOffsets) change because the writer relocates image data"
   ],
   "destinations": {
    "exif": true,
    "xmp": true,
    "iptc": true
   },
   "removal": {
    "categories": [
     "location",
     "captureTime",
     "descriptive",
     "rights",
     "deviceIdentity"
    ],
    "recipes": {
     "deviceIdentity": "named serial-number keys only; MakerNote and DNGPrivateData are never deleted"
    },
    "forbiddenArguments": [
     "-EXIF:all=",
     "-IFD0:all=",
     "-all="
    ],
    "thumbnails": {
     "supported": false,
     "reason": "preview IFDs are protected image data"
    }
   },
   "minimise": {
    "supported": false,
    "code": "MINIMISE_UNSUPPORTED_CONTAINER",
    "reason": "IFD0 is the image description"
   },
   "timeLocationWrite": true,
   "refusalCodes": [
    "TIFF_BIG_UNSUPPORTED",
    "TIFF_LAYOUT_OVERLAP",
    "TIFF_IMAGE_EXTENT_INVALID",
    "TIFF_IFD_BUDGET",
    "TIFF_TYPE_UNSUPPORTED",
    "TIFF_UNKNOWN_IFD_POINTER",
    "TIFF_UNKNOWN_OFFSET_SUSPECT",
    "TIFF_OFFSET_TAG_UNSUPPORTED",
    "RAW_FORMAT_UNSUPPORTED",
    "IPTC_RESOURCE_TAIL_UNSUPPORTED",
    "TIFF_PHOTOSHOP_IPTC_CARRIER_UNSUPPORTED",
    "TIFF_IPTC_DIGEST_UNSUPPORTED"
   ],
   "limitations": [
    "tiffUnknownTagSemanticsNotInterpreted",
    "tiffRecognisedTagSetConservative",
    "makerNoteMayIdentifyDevice",
    "rawImageDigestNotRecomputed",
    "photoshopResourceTailOpaque",
    "tiffPhotoshopIptcCarrierWriteUnsupported",
    "tiffIptcDigestNotRefreshable"
   ]
  },
  "png": {
   "locator": "png",
   "signatures": [
    "89504e470d0a1a0a"
   ],
   "suffixes": [
    ".png"
   ],
   "maxBytes": 67108864,
   "slots": {
    "exif": "eXIf chunk",
    "xmp": "iTXt chunk XML:com.adobe.xmp",
    "iptc": null
   },
   "protected": [
    "every critical chunk in order (IDAT per chunk)",
    "every ancillary chunk that is not a metadata slot or text chunk, whole and in order",
    "text chunks other than XMP unless a removal category selects them by keyword"
   ],
   "allowedChanges": [
    "insert, replace or remove eXIf before the first IDAT",
    "insert, replace or remove the XMP iTXt before the first IDAT"
   ],
   "nativeSideEffects": [
    "exifMandatoryYCbCrPositioning"
   ],
   "destinations": {
    "exif": true,
    "xmp": true,
    "iptc": false
   },
   "removal": {
    "categories": [
     "location",
     "captureTime",
     "descriptive",
     "rights",
     "deviceIdentity"
    ],
    "recipes": {
     "exif": "category removals: named keys from the trusted listing of the capture; minimise (AM-19): -EXIF:all= (the E2 closed reset, only when the Exif block holds more than the kept rendering values) and then the exact keep-set write-back as numeric assignments, for example -IFD0:Orientation#=6, with the capture's -ExifByteOrder=",
     "xmp": "-XMP:all=",
     "text": "PNG:<Keyword> keys the locator reports as tEXt, zTXt or iTXt"
    },
    "forbiddenArguments": [
     "-PNG:all=",
     "-all="
    ]
   },
   "minimise": {
    "supported": true,
    "rule": "AM-17 semantics with the AM-19 method: the Exif block is reset with -EXIF:all= (only when it holds more than the kept values), the XMP block with -XMP:all= and every PNG text chunk by its PNG:<Keyword> key, never -all= or -PNG:all=; the independently read E2 keep-set (Exif Orientation, YCbCrPositioning, ColorSpace, InteropIndex) is written back with numeric assignments such as -IFD0:Orientation#=6 and the capture's -ExifByteOrder=; refused with MINIMISE_RENDERING_UNPRESERVED when a keep-set value cannot be kept faithfully; the closed residual proof, the native closed diff and the byte-level protection of gamma, colour profile and image data stay authoritative",
    "keep": [
     "EXIF:Orientation",
     "EXIF:YCbCrPositioning",
     "EXIF:ColorSpace"
    ],
    "residuals": [
     "pngModificationTimeKept"
    ]
   },
   "timeLocationWrite": true,
   "refusalCodes": [
    "PNG_CRC_INVALID",
    "PNG_TRAILING_BYTES",
    "PNG_METADATA_AFTER_IDAT",
    "PNG_LEGACY_RAW_PROFILE",
    "PNG_DUPLICATE_CHUNK",
    "PNG_CHUNK_ORDER_INVALID",
    "XMP_BOUND"
   ],
   "limitations": [
    "pngLegacyRawProfileReadOnly",
    "iptcNotAvailableInContainer"
   ]
  },
  "webp": {
   "locator": "riff",
   "signatures": [
    "52494646"
   ],
   "detect": "RIFF header with WEBP form type at byte 8",
   "suffixes": [
    ".webp"
   ],
   "maxBytes": 67108864,
   "slots": {
    "exif": "EXIF chunk",
    "xmp": "XMP chunk",
    "iptc": null
   },
   "protected": [
    "VP8X canvas and the I, L and A flags",
    "ICCP, ANIM, every ANMF, ALPH, VP8, VP8L and unknown chunks, padding bytes included, in order"
   ],
   "allowedChanges": [
    "EXIF and XMP chunk insert, replace or remove after the image data",
    "VP8X E and X flags",
    "VP8X creation or removal only as predicted and proved by the AM-16R rules",
    "RIFF size"
   ],
   "nativeSideEffects": [
    "vp8xOutcomePredictedAndProved",
    "exifMandatoryYCbCrPositioning"
   ],
   "destinations": {
    "exif": true,
    "xmp": true,
    "iptc": false
   },
   "removal": {
    "categories": [
     "location",
     "captureTime",
     "descriptive",
     "rights",
     "deviceIdentity"
    ],
    "recipes": {
     "exif": "category removals: named keys from the trusted listing of the capture; minimise (AM-19): -EXIF:all= (the E2 closed reset, only when the Exif block holds more than the kept rendering values) and then the exact keep-set write-back as numeric assignments, for example -IFD0:Orientation#=6, with the capture's -ExifByteOrder=",
     "xmp": "-XMP:all="
    },
    "forbiddenArguments": [
     "-all=",
     "ICC profile deletion"
    ],
    "vp8x": {
     "rule": "AM-16R",
     "refusalCode": "WEBP_METADATA_REMOVAL_LAYOUT_UNSUPPORTED",
     "afterWriteCodes": [
      "WEBP_LAYOUT_INVALID_AFTER_WRITE",
      "WEBP_FLAGS_INCONSISTENT",
      "PRESERVATION_MISMATCH"
     ]
    }
   },
   "minimise": {
    "supported": true,
    "rule": "AM-17 semantics with the AM-19 method: the Exif block is reset with -EXIF:all= (only when it holds more than the kept values) and the XMP block with -XMP:all=, never -all=; the independently read E2 keep-set (Exif Orientation, YCbCrPositioning, ColorSpace, InteropIndex) is written back with numeric assignments such as -IFD0:YCbCrPositioning#=2 and the capture's -ExifByteOrder=; refused with MINIMISE_RENDERING_UNPRESERVED when a keep-set value cannot be kept faithfully; the closed residual proof, the native closed diff, the AM-16R layout proof and the byte-level protection of ICC, alpha, animation and image data stay authoritative",
    "keep": [
     "EXIF:Orientation",
     "EXIF:YCbCrPositioning",
     "EXIF:ColorSpace"
    ],
    "residuals": [
     "webpVp8xRemovedWhenNoChunkNeedsIt"
    ]
   },
   "timeLocationWrite": true,
   "refusalCodes": [
    "RIFF_SIZE_MISMATCH",
    "RIFF_TRAILING_BYTES",
    "RIFF_PADDING_INVALID",
    "WEBP_EXIF_PREFIX_UNSUPPORTED",
    "WEBP_DUPLICATE_METADATA_CHUNK",
    "WEBP_CANVAS_MISMATCH",
    "WEBP_LAYOUT_UNSUPPORTED",
    "WEBP_BITSTREAM_HEADER_SHORT",
    "WEBP_METADATA_REMOVAL_LAYOUT_UNSUPPORTED",
    "WEBP_LAYOUT_INVALID_AFTER_WRITE",
    "WEBP_FLAGS_INCONSISTENT"
   ],
   "limitations": [
    "iptcNotAvailableInContainer",
    "rf64Unsupported"
   ]
  },
  "heif": {
   "locator": "isobmff",
   "signatures": [
    "ftyp"
   ],
   "detect": "ftyp box at byte 4 with brand heic, heix, mif1 or avif",
   "suffixes": [
    ".heic",
    ".heif",
    ".avif"
   ],
   "maxBytes": 67108864,
   "slots": {
    "exif": "Exif item linked to the primary image by iref cdsc",
    "xmp": "mime item application/rdf+xml linked by iref cdsc",
    "iptc": null
   },
   "protected": [
    "ftyp, hdlr and pitm",
    "whole infe box and reassembled payload of every item that is not a primary-image metadata slot",
    "iprp (ipco and ipma)",
    "every iref entry except cdsc entries from slot items",
    "other meta children and top-level boxes other than ftyp, meta, mdat, free and skip"
   ],
   "allowedChanges": [
    "slot item payloads with their iinf, iloc and cdsc entries",
    "iloc offsets of every item (relocation)",
    "mdat size and position",
    "free and skip boxes"
   ],
   "nativeSideEffects": [
    "QuickTime:MediaDataSize",
    "QuickTime:MediaDataOffset",
    "exifMandatoryYCbCrPositioning"
   ],
   "destinations": {
    "exif": true,
    "xmp": true,
    "iptc": false
   },
   "removal": {
    "categories": [],
    "unsupportedCode": "HEIF_REMOVAL_UNSUPPORTED",
    "reason": "native all= leaves Exif and XMP items with extent_length 0, which resolves to the image payload"
   },
   "minimise": {
    "supported": false,
    "code": "MINIMISE_UNSUPPORTED_CONTAINER",
    "reason": "removal is unsupported"
   },
   "timeLocationWrite": true,
   "refusalCodes": [
    "HEIF_BOUND",
    "HEIF_IMPLIED_EXTENT",
    "HEIF_EXTENT_OVERLAP",
    "HEIF_MULTIPLE_METADATA_ITEMS",
    "HEIF_SHARED_METADATA_ITEM",
    "HEIF_REFERENCE_INVALID",
    "HEIF_PROTECTED_ITEM",
    "HEIF_EXTERNAL_DATA",
    "HEIF_ITEM_CONSTRUCTION_UNSUPPORTED",
    "HEIF_EXIF_HEADER_INVALID",
    "HEIF_REMOVAL_UNSUPPORTED",
    "HEIF_METADATA_ITEM_CREATION_UNSUPPORTED",
    "HEIF_EMPTY_METADATA_ITEM"
   ],
   "limitations": [
    "heifSpecDraftOnly",
    "heifRemovalUnsupported",
    "heifNativeMetadataCreationNotReproducible",
    "iptcNotAvailableInContainer"
   ]
  }
 },
 "unsupported": {
  "bigtiff": {
   "code": "TIFF_BIG_UNSUPPORTED",
   "reason": "BigTIFF is not writable by ExifTool 13.55"
  },
  "makerRaw": {
   "code": "RAW_FORMAT_UNSUPPORTED",
   "reason": "maker TIFF variants have image and maker structures that cannot be protected generally"
  },
  "jpegxl": {
   "code": "UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA",
   "reason": "not located"
  },
  "gif": {
   "code": "UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA",
   "reason": "not located"
  }
 }
}
